answer_card.title: Slow Lightspeed chat with Granite 3.3
answer_card.answer_md:
Known issue (AAP-58186): with an IBM Granite 3.3 model the Ansible Lightspeed intelligent assistant can take ~1 minute to reply.

**Workaround:** restart the chat session.
